parsed.explanation: The write-up correctly identifies the move's effect on valuations, (α,β) ↦ (min(α,β), |α−β|), and correctly formulates the needed divisor equivalence, but then writes '(standard; details omitted)' and asserts 'In all cases $G_p$ is invariant' without treating any case: α=β, α or β zero, α>β vs α<β. No other passage supplies the argument: Step 4 only uses gcd(x,0)=x on the terminal tuple, and the Remarks are consistency checks on special boards, plus computer verification, which the rubric does not credit. So the invariance mechanism is named/sketched, not proved for all cases. A one-sentence proof (t | α, β ⇔ t | min, |α−β|, since each side is an integer combination of the other) repairs it.
